_comment: Registry for the CODE platform. Adding a language = one entry here + code/<id>/chapters/. 'kind' is full (complete track: 3 projects) or mini (compressed, 1 project). 'status' live|planned drives how the hub page renders the card. 'store' is the localStorage key; python keeps its original one so existing progress survives.
